description.zh:
资源组显示名称。

长度为1~50个字符或汉字。
description.en:
The display name of the resource group.

It must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

description.zh:
资源组唯一标识。

长度为2~50个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。必须以英文字母开头。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the resource group.

It must be 2 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

descriptions.zh: > 一个阿里云账号下最多创建30个资源组。
descriptions.en: >  A maximum of 30 resource groups can be created within an Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager create-resource-group --name my-project --display-name my-project --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager CreateResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key k1 --Tag.1.Value v1 --DisplayName 'my-project' --Name 'my-project' --method POST --force
